scenes.audio: The fourth point is that the entire video has a complete set of rules.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A clean, minimalist white environment. A thin, horizontal black line appears in the center, which expands vertically to reveal a list of points on a white digital document labeled 'episode-assembly.md'. The lighting is bright and even across the digital canvas. The camera is static, focusing on the center of the frame.

scenes.audio: How to organize the handover between segments and how to self-check before rendering.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Two white rounded rectangular cards slide into the frame from the bottom. The card on the left shows a diagram of a video frame transition, while the card on the right displays a terminal-style command line execution. The background remains a sterile, high-key white. Smooth motion graphics represent a digital workflow.

scenes.audio: The maximum number of times sound effects can be placed,
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The camera pans to the right to reveal a new white card labeled 'sound-effects.md'. Inside the card, several circular icons representing sound points appear along a horizontal line. The icons animate with a slight 'pop' effect as they appear. The color palette is strictly grayscale and white.

scenes.audio: Including where the background music should be placed and where it should not be placed.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The view shifts to a card labeled 'background-music.md'. An audio waveform visualization appears below several UI buttons. The waveform is represented by thin vertical black bars of varying heights that animate to simulate sound playback.

scenes.audio: Rendering issues are also solved together. This includes things like large file uploads being interrupted and then resuming.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: Three horizontal progress bars appear stacked vertically. The top bar shows an upload process. An 'X' icon appears indicating a break in the connection, followed by the bar resuming from the point of failure to show a resume-upload function. The animation is smooth and linear.

scenes.audio: If it gets stuck halfway during rendering, it will automatically retry, and the audio will no longer clip or distort.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: The focus moves to the middle and bottom bars. The middle bar shows a rendering process with segmented blocks filling up. The bottom bar displays a complex audio waveform with a digital limiter indicator appearing on the right side, showing a -1.3 dBTP peak value.
